import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static class ModInt {
        int val;

        ModInt(long v) {
            v %= MOD;
            if (v < 0) v += MOD;
            val = (int) v;
        }

        ModInt(int v) {
            val = v % MOD;
            if (val < 0) val += MOD;
        }

        ModInt() {
            val = 0;
        }

        ModInt add(ModInt o) {
            val = (val + o.val) % MOD;
            return this;
        }

        ModInt sub(ModInt o) {
            val = (val - o.val + MOD) % MOD;
            return this;
        }

        ModInt mul(ModInt o) {
            val = (int) ((long) val * o.val % MOD);
            return this;
        }

        ModInt div(ModInt o) {
            return mul(o.inv());
        }

        ModInt neg() {
            return val != 0 ? new ModInt(MOD - val) : new ModInt(0);
        }

        boolean equals(ModInt o) {
            return val == o.val;
        }

        ModInt inv() {
            int a = val, b = MOD, x = 0, y = 1;
            while (a > 1) {
                int q = a / b;
                int temp = a % b;
                a = b;
                b = temp;
                temp = x - q * y;
                x = y;
                y = temp;
            }
            return x < 0 ? new ModInt(x + MOD) : new ModInt(x);
        }

        ModInt pow(long p) {
            ModInt res = new ModInt(1);
            ModInt a = new ModInt(val);
            while (p > 0) {
                if ((p & 1) == 1) res.mul(a);
                a.mul(a);
                p >>= 1;
            }
            return res;
        }

        static ModInt add(ModInt a, ModInt b) {
            return new ModInt(a.val).add(b);
        }

        static ModInt sub(ModInt a, ModInt b) {
            return new ModInt(a.val).sub(b);
        }

        static ModInt mul(ModInt a, ModInt b) {
            return new ModInt(a.val).mul(b);
        }

        static ModInt div(ModInt a, ModInt b) {
            return new ModInt(a.val).div(b);
        }
    }

    static class SafeHash {
        private static final long FIXED_RANDOM;

        static {
            long seed = System.nanoTime();
            FIXED_RANDOM = splitmix64(seed * ((long) (new Object().hashCode()) | 1));
        }

        private static long splitmix64(long x) {
            x += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15L;
            x = (x ^ (x >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9L;
            x = (x ^ (x >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111ebL;
            return x ^ (x >> 31);
        }

        public int hash(long x) {
            return (int) splitmix64(x ^ FIXED_RANDOM);
        }
    }

    static final int N_MAX = 10;
    static int N;
    static ModInt[][] probability = new ModInt[N_MAX][N_MAX];

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        N = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            String[] line = br.readLine().split(" ");
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                int p = Integer.parseInt(line[j]);
                probability[i][j] = new ModInt(p).div(new ModInt(100));
            }
        }

        List<List<Integer>> masksWithCount = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
            masksWithCount.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }

        int[] lookup = new int[1 << N];
        Arrays.fill(lookup, -1);

        for (int mask = 0; mask < 1 << N; mask++) {
            int cnt = Integer.bitCount(mask);
            lookup[mask] = masksWithCount.get(cnt).size();
            masksWithCount.get(cnt).add(mask);
        }

        Map<Long, ModInt> possibleMasks = new HashMap<>();
        possibleMasks.put(1L << lookup[0], new ModInt(1));

        for (int left = 0; left < N; left++) {
            Map<Long, ModInt> newPossibleMasks = new HashMap<>();
            ModInt[] products = new ModInt[1 << N];
            for (int i = 0; i < (1 << N); i++) {
                products[i] = new ModInt(1);
            }

            for (int current = 0; current < 1 << N; current++) {
                ModInt prod = new ModInt(1);
                for (int right = 0; right < N; right++) {
                    if ((current >> right & 1) == 1) {
                        prod = ModInt.mul(prod, probability[left][right]);
                    } else {
                        ModInt one = new ModInt(1);
                        ModInt prob = probability[left][right];
                        ModInt complement = ModInt.sub(one, prob);
                        prod = ModInt.mul(prod, complement);
                    }
                }
                products[current] = prod;
            }

            long[] newBits = new long[N];
            long[] newPossible = new long[1 << N];

            for (Map.Entry<Long, ModInt> entry : possibleMasks.entrySet()) {
                long possible = entry.getKey();
                ModInt probVal = entry.getValue();

                Arrays.fill(newBits, 0);
                for (int mask : masksWithCount.get(left)) {
                    if ((possible >> lookup[mask] & 1) == 1) {
                        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                            if ((mask >> i & 1) == 0) {
                                newBits[i] |= 1L << lookup[mask | (1 << i)];
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                newPossible[0] = 0;
                for (int current = 1; current < 1 << N; current++) {
                    newPossible[current] = newPossible[current & (current - 1)] | newBits[Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(current)];
                    ModInt productVal = products[current];
                    ModInt productWithProb = ModInt.mul(probVal, productVal);
                    long key = newPossible[current];
                    newPossibleMasks.put(key, ModInt.add(newPossibleMasks.getOrDefault(key, new ModInt(0)), productWithProb));
                }
            }

            possibleMasks = newPossibleMasks;
        }

        ModInt answer = new ModInt(0);
        int fullMask = (1 << N) - 1;
        for (Map.Entry<Long, ModInt> entry : possibleMasks.entrySet()) {
            if ((entry.getKey() >> lookup[fullMask] & 1) == 1) {
                answer = ModInt.add(answer, entry.getValue());
            }
        }
        System.out.println(answer.val);
    }
}
